ns2:section.sectionText: Umfundalai is a contemporary African dance technique that comprises its movement vocabulary from dance traditions from the continent of Africa as well as societies throughout the Diaspora. Contemporary African Dance uses Umfundalai to provide students with a rigorous movement experience that will focus on alignment, rhythm, and style as competencies in proficient, African-informed movement practice.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s).
